purpose: Promise an action immediately after a prerequisite is completed.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
I will contact you as soon as it arrives.
We will leave as soon as we are ready.
We will let you know as soon as we have the details.
restrictions: The second action is normally intentional and often future-oriented.
mistake: Use Vたら for an ordinary past sequence.

segments.role: Promise an action immediately after a prerequisite is completed. Vます stem + 次第
